meta.title: About — Australia Construction Consultants & Associates
meta.description: ACCA is an Australian construction consultancy — senior-level advisors, client-side only. Managing Director: Antonio Hernandez.

intro.headline: Independent representation for the party paying the fee.

why.heading: How we work
body: Australia Construction Consultants & Associates is a consultancy established in 1984. We work on the owner's side of the table — for developers, principals, and property owners — never for the builder in the same matter.
Every engagement is scoped in writing before we start, with named deliverables, a fee, and a date. Where the shape of the job allows it, the fee is fixed.
For superintendent engagements our duty is to the contract, not the retaining party — and we hold that line in writing.

people.name: Antonio Hernandez
people.bio: Antonio leads ACCA's engagements across contract advisory, risk, feasibility, estimating, compliance, and project management. Direct line to every project the firm takes on.
